item.text:
**Verdict**
Mixed, leaning no. I found some real evidence of professionalization and measurement in social-service adjacent areas, but little direct proof that Trọng personally used transparent performance feedback to improve delivery. The strongest counterevidence is that the anti-graft campaign created administrative paralysis and exposed patronage/mismanagement inside the labor-social affairs system.

**Accepted Claims**

- **UNICEF applauds Viet Nam's progress establishment social work and counseling** | UNICEF Viet Nam | 2024 | [URL](https://www.unicef.org/vietnam/press-releases/unicef-applauds-viet-nams-progress-establishment-social-work-and-counseling) | UNICEF says the government created defined social-worker posts in health facilities and school-counselor posts in primary-to-secondary schools, with technical support for university-trained social workers. This is the clearest evidence of moving service delivery toward professional staff rather than pure patronage. | IDs: 6B.5, 6B.4, 6B.3

- **Decree 110/2024/NĐ-CP on social work** | Thuvienphapluat / Government of Vietnam | 2024-08-30 | [URL](https://thuvienphapluat.vn/van-ban/EN/Van-hoa-Xa-hoi/Decree-110-2024-ND-CP-social-work/627226/tieng-anh.aspx?tab=0) | The decree sets rules for social-work clients, practitioners, eligibility, and practice. That is evidence of formal rules and professional standards, which supports a limited “measure and regulate” reading. | IDs: 6B.5, 6B.4

- **Agencies urged fix shortcomings in child care protection this year** | Vietnam News | 2024-01-12 | [URL](https://vietnamnews.vn/society/1639130/agencies-urged-fix-shortcomings-in-child-care-protection-this-year.html) | The Deputy PM directed agencies to implement child-care and protection programs, including anti-abuse, school safety, cyberspace safety, counseling, and stimulant-use measures. This shows some operational correction, though the evidence is programmatic rather than a transparent performance regime. | IDs: 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **Viet Nam’s economy poised for gradual recovery, World Bank report finds** | World Bank | 2024-04-23 | [URL](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/04/23/viet-nam-s-economy-poised-for-gradual-recovery-world-bank-report-finds) | The Bank uses diagnostics to identify gaps in social assistance, higher-education access, and support for ethnic minorities and disadvantaged students. This is evidence of measurement-based diagnosis, but also that service delivery remained incomplete. | IDs: 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **Vietnam 2024 Article IV Consultation** | IMF | 2024-09-27 | [URL](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/09/27/vietnam-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-the-555679) | IMF says revised land, housing, real-estate, and credit-institution laws should reduce legal uncertainty and improve transparency. This supports a technical-correction reading, but it is broader governance and macro policy rather than direct service-delivery management. | IDs: 6B.5, 5B.7, 5B.9, 5B.10

- **Vietnam labor minister rebuked for mismanagement amid anti-graft campaign** | VnExpress International / Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [URL](https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/crime/vietnam-labor-minister-rebuked-for-mismanagement-4736499.html) | The Politburo reprimanded the labor minister for failures that allowed violations in ministry-linked bidding and management, including packages tied to vocational training and social resources. This is strong counterevidence: it shows weak oversight and patronage risk inside a social-services ministry. | IDs: 6B.5, 6B.4

- **Analysis: Vietnam’s sweeping administrative cuts stir investors' anticipation, worries** | Reuters / Investing.com | 2024-12-17 | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/analysisvietnams-sweeping-administrative-cuts-stir-investors-anticipation-worries-3776157) | Reuters describes the bureaucratic overhaul as an attempt to cut red tape, but also notes risks of short-term paralysis and delays. That weakens any claim of steady, transparent correction in the service state. | IDs: 6B.5, 5B.7, 5B.9, 5B.10

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong direct 2024 evidence that Trọng personally ran a transparent service-delivery dashboard, public KPI system, or feedback loop for health, education, water, sanitation, or housing.
- The strongest positive material is sectoral and institutional, not personal: social-work professionalization, child-protection directives, and diagnostics from UNICEF, World Bank, and IMF.
- The strongest negative material is administrative: labor-ministry mismanagement, anti-graft turbulence, and bureaucratic delays.
